informal_statement: The one-axis closure census, rendered at the census scale x = d/sqrt(n) with hbar held fixed, converges to the stationary Euclidean functional x^2 in value, first variation and curvature; this is one continuum rendering of the proved discrete stationarity at ZFA balance, not the physical (Lorentzian) action principle.

approximation_or_regime.name: Central census scaling
approximation_or_regime.description: d = floor(x sqrt n) up-steps off balance in a 2n-step one-axis history, n -> infinity; the cost is I_n(d) = log W_n(n) - log W_n(n+d) with W_n(k) = C(2n,k).
approximation_or_regime.validity_limits: One axis, unsigned census, x >= 0 (the other side by conjugate symmetry). Euclidean large-deviation weight only. No phase e^{iS/hbar}, no field or geometry reconstruction, no gravity, no event-selection claim (first closure is priority).

formal_statement.statement_scope: Exact finite sandwich d^2/(n+d) <= I_n(d) <= d^2/(n-d+1) for d <= n; I_n(floor(x sqrt n)) -> x^2; sqrt(n)(I_n(d+1) - I_n(d)) -> 2x proved separately from the value limit; n(I_n(1) + I_n(-1) - 2 I_n(0)) -> 2; I_n(d) = 0 iff d = 0. These establish #303 level S-MATH for this functional. They do not identify the functional with a physical action (S3-S5), do not construct a reconstruction map on fields (S6-S7), and say nothing about Benincasa-Dowker/Einstein-Hilbert (S8-S10). Link sector (QLF_LinkClosure): stationarity of the finite link action, sourced by a history's signed link current, under every single-link variation forces the history to be count-balanced and to return; the converse (finite Hodge) is checked exactly by link_closure.py, not proved.

formal_object.type: normalized log-binomial census cost and its scaling limit

dependencies.qlf_bridge_axioms: None. Footprints are propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only.

interpretation.map: balanced one-axis census -> log-count cost I_n -> scaled functional x^2 -> minimizer and curvature returned to the count
interpretation.formal_status: The census-to-functional limit and its variations are formal. The reading of -log W as a physical action is an identification, not a theorem.
interpretation.noncircularity_test: The limit x^2 is computed from C(2n,k) by elementary log bounds; no quadratic form is assumed. Derivative convergence is proved separately (K3 of #303). K4 is run numerically: 1 - W(n+d)/W(n) has the same discrete mode but limit 1 - exp(-x^2), so the log normalization is a choice the limit inherits.

strange_loop.name: census stationarity -> continuum functional -> mode and curvature returned
levels: continuum functional x^2 at scale x = d/sqrt n
strange_loop.return_level: the discrete mode (balance) and the exact second difference at balance
strange_loop.conservative_return: The continuum minimizer x = 0 returns to d = 0, which is balance_is_mode (censusCost_eq_zero_iff), and the continuum curvature 2 is recovered from the exact count as the limit of n times the second difference at balance (censusCost_curvature_limit). This is a return on the census functional only; no return through a physical action or reconstructed field exists.
strange_loop.noncircularity_witness: The quadratic limit, its derivative 2x and curvature 2 are outputs of exact binomial identities and log bounds, not inputs. A biased alphabet (biased_first_variation) moves the mode off balance, so the return could fail.
strange_loop.first_order_note: F: the Lean anchors listed. N: census_action_limit.py reproduces the limits numerically (floating point, not a certificate).
strange_loop.defeater: A census in which conjugate symmetry holds but the scaled variation fails to converge to the derivative of the limit; or a physical action whose stationary point is not returned by this functional.

proof_obligation.domain: balanced one-axis census histories of length 2n
proof_obligation.return_map: continuum minimizer and curvature -> d = 0 and the exact second difference at balance
proof_obligation.composite_identity_on: the mode and the curvature at balance
proof_obligation.imported_axioms: none in Lean; physical reading of -log W as action is an identification
proof_obligation.falsifier: a stationary physical action (link action, signed propagator) whose discrete stationary point differs from the census mode

observable.symbol: I_n(floor(x sqrt n)), sqrt(n) Delta I_n, n Delta^2 I_n(0)
observable.uncertainties: exact sandwich; error O(1/n) when x sqrt n is an integer, O(1/sqrt n) from the floor otherwise

measurement_protocol.design: Formal limits in Lean; numerical companion census_action_limit.py.
measurement_protocol.failure_condition: A Lean counterexample to the sandwich, or a companion run violating the sandwich.

evidence.F: Exact sandwich, value limit, variation limit, curvature return and unique minimizer, no QLF axiom. Link sector: stationary link action forces count balance and return of its source history; unbalanced histories admit no stationary configuration.
evidence.N: census_action_limit.py: sandwich checked against exact binomials for n in {5, 12, 40}; limits shown to n = 10^6. link_closure.py: exact rational check that a stationary configuration exists iff the history is count-balanced, on (Z3)^2, (Z4)^2, (Z3)^3, (Z3)^4.

defeaters.interpretation: -log W is not a physical action; the Lorentzian phase needs a separate signed construction (S3-S5).
defeaters.numerical: A companion run outside the sandwich.
defeaters.conceptual: The census mode is a frequency statistic, not the priority rule (depth_one_not_modal).
